title: Silppi Constructions Contractors v. Union of India
bench: Deepak Gupta aur Surya Kant, JJ.
summary: Kochi mein 53 aur 72 crore ke do kaamon ke tender mein petitioner firm ki technical bid radd hui. SLP Supreme Court mein aayi.
held: Contract ke maamlon mein court bahut sanyam se kaam le. Tender nikaalne wala authority apni zarooraton ka sabse achha judge hai, aur do vyakhya sambhav hon to uski vyakhya maani jaaye (para 19–20). Kaun 'necessary party' hai, yeh tathyon par nirbhar hai. Award ho chuke contract ki chunauti mein sthiti alag ho sakti hai (para 21). SLPs dismissed.
use: Para 20: judicial review mein dakhal kam se kam ho.
Para 21: award ho chuke contract ko chunauti mein successful bidders ki maujoodgi zaroori. Yahan unhe court ne 25.02.2026 ko party banwaya.
caution: Yeh bhi technical eligibility par hai, domicile par nahi.
